def check_ip_in_10(ip):
    parts = ip + ".0.0.0.0"
    segments = []
    current = ""
    for ch in parts:
        if ch == ".":
            segments = segments + [current]
            current = ""
        else:
            current = current + ch
    first = int(segments[0]) if len(segments) > 0 else -1
    return first == 10

fa = fgt.get("log_fortianalyzer")
fa_status = fa["status"] if "status" in fa else "disable"
fa_server = fa["server"] if "server" in fa else ""
if fa_status == "enable" and fa_server != "":
    report.finding("chk-0001", "pass", "FortiAnalyzer habilitado, servidor: " + str(fa_server), endpoints_used=["log_fortianalyzer"])
else:
    report.finding("chk-0001", "fail", "FortiAnalyzer no habilitado o sin servidor. status=" + str(fa_status) + " server=" + str(fa_server), endpoints_used=["log_fortianalyzer"])

sl = fgt.get("log_syslogd")
sl_status = sl["status"] if "status" in sl else "disable"
sl_server = sl["server"] if "server" in sl else ""
if sl_status == "enable" and sl_server != "":
    report.finding("chk-0002", "pass", "Syslog habilitado, servidor: " + str(sl_server), endpoints_used=["log_syslogd"])
else:
    report.finding("chk-0002", "fail", "Syslog no habilitado o sin servidor. status=" + str(sl_status) + " server=" + str(sl_server), endpoints_used=["log_syslogd"])

ls = fgt.get("log_settings")
ls_fwpolicy = ls["fwpolicy-implicit-log"] if "fwpolicy-implicit-log" in ls else "disable"
ls_local = ls["local-in-allow"] if "local-in-allow" in ls else "disable"
ls_forward = ls["forward-traffic"] if "forward-traffic" in ls else "disable"
ls_event = ls["event"] if "event" in ls else "disable"
issues = []
if ls_forward != "enable":
    issues = issues + ["forward-traffic=" + str(ls_forward)]
if ls_event != "enable":
    issues = issues + ["event=" + str(ls_event)]
if len(issues) == 0:
    report.finding("chk-0003", "pass", "Log settings activo. forward-traffic=" + str(ls_forward) + " event=" + str(ls_event), endpoints_used=["log_settings"])
else:
    ev = ""
    for i in issues:
        ev = ev + i + " "
    report.finding("chk-0003", "fail", "Log settings incompleto: " + ev, endpoints_used=["log_settings"])

fps = fgt.get("firewall_policies")
bad_policies = []
for pol in fps:
    lt = pol["logtraffic"] if "logtraffic" in pol else "disable"
    if lt != "all":
        pid = pol["policyid"] if "policyid" in pol else "unknown"
        pname = pol["name"] if "name" in pol else ""
        bad_policies = bad_policies + [str(pid) + "(" + str(pname) + "):logtraffic=" + str(lt)]
if len(bad_policies) == 0:
    report.finding("chk-0004", "pass", "Todas las politicas tienen logtraffic=all. Total=" + str(len(fps)), endpoints_used=["firewall_policies"])
else:
    ev2 = ""
    for b in bad_policies:
        ev2 = ev2 + b + "; "
    report.finding("chk-0004", "fail", "Politicas sin logtraffic=all: " + ev2, endpoints_used=["firewall_policies"])

ntp_data = fgt.get("ntp")
ntp_status = ntp_data["ntpsync"] if "ntpsync" in ntp_data else "disable"
ntp_servers = ntp_data["ntpserver"] if "ntpserver" in ntp_data else []
if ntp_status == "enable" and len(ntp_servers) > 0:
    srv_ev = ""
    for s in ntp_servers:
        sname = s["server"] if "server" in s else str(s)
        srv_ev = srv_ev + sname + " "
    report.finding("chk-0005", "pass", "NTP habilitado. Servidores: " + srv_ev, endpoints_used=["ntp"])
else:
    report.finding("chk-0005", "fail", "NTP no habilitado o sin servidores. ntpsync=" + str(ntp_status) + " servidores=" + str(len(ntp_servers)), endpoints_used=["ntp"])

sg = fgt.get("system_global")
tz = sg["timezone"] if "timezone" in sg else ""
buenos_aires_tz = "28"
buenos_aires_name = "America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires"
if str(tz) == buenos_aires_tz or str(tz) == buenos_aires_name:
    report.finding("chk-0006", "pass", "Zona horaria correcta: " + str(tz), endpoints_used=["system_global"])
else:
    report.finding("chk-0006", "fail", "Zona horaria incorrecta: " + str(tz) + " (esperado: " + buenos_aires_name + " o " + buenos_aires_tz + ")", endpoints_used=["system_global"])

dns_data = fgt.get("dns")
dns_primary = dns_data["primary"] if "primary" in dns_data else ""
dns_secondary = dns_data["secondary"] if "secondary" in dns_data else ""
p_ok = check_ip_in_10(str(dns_primary)) if dns_primary != "" else False
s_ok = check_ip_in_10(str(dns_secondary)) if dns_secondary != "" else True
if p_ok and s_ok:
    report.finding("chk-0007", "pass", "DNS en rango 10.x. primario=" + str(dns_primary) + " secundario=" + str(dns_secondary), endpoints_used=["dns"])
else:
    report.finding("chk-0007", "fail", "DNS fuera de rango 10.x. primario=" + str(dns_primary) + " secundario=" + str(dns_secondary), endpoints_used=["dns"])

hostname = sg["hostname"] if "hostname" in sg else ""
prefix_ok = len(str(hostname)) >= 4 and str(hostname)[0] == "F" and str(hostname)[1] == "G" and str(hostname)[2] == "T" and str(hostname)[3] == "-"
if prefix_ok:
    report.finding("chk-0008", "pass", "Hostname cumple prefijo FGT-: " + str(hostname), endpoints_used=["system_global"])
else:
    report.finding("chk-0008", "fail", "Hostname no cumple prefijo FGT-: " + str(hostname), endpoints_used=["system_global"])
